title: Hunter's Dagger
summary: A +1 dagger whose melee hits Rupture targets for 3 turns.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d4 + 1 Piercing, 5 ft melee, simple, one-handed, light, finesse, thrown and dippable.
fields.Rupturing: Melee hits with this dagger or its weapon actions apply or refresh Ruptured for 3 turns. The source reports no saving throw despite the DC 13 tooltip. Throwing the dagger does not apply Ruptured.
fields.Ruptured: Take 1d4 Piercing per 3 ft of ordinary movement and lose one turn of duration per damage trigger. Jumping, teleporting and being shoved do not trigger it. Undead and Constructs can be affected.
fields.Weapon actions: With proficiency, gain Flourish, Piercing Strike and Lacerate.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Roah Moonglow; it can reappear after a stock reset.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
